_note: PROTOTYPE draft canon for wayfinder ticket #142. Throwaway: drafted by the prototype agent following the canon rules decided in #140, not owner-approved. Canon fixes identity only; the scene plan decides pose, expression, action and situational details.
rules: All people are historically grounded ancient Near Eastern people (olive-to-brown skin, dark hair), in every art style.
God is never shown as a human figure: the LORD's presence appears only as light, cloud, fire or wind.

lifeStages.appliesTo: Gospels and Acts (one stage; the story spans only a few years)
lifeStages.build: stocky and broad-shouldered, thick forearms, heavy calloused fisherman's hands
lifeStages.hairAndBeard: short, tight black curls receding at the temples; a short, dense, curly black beard with one white-grey streak at the centre of the chin
lifeStages.facialNotes: broad square face, heavy brow, a crooked once-broken nose bending to his right, a short pale scar through his left eyebrow, deep-set dark eyes
lifeStages.garments: knee-length undyed oatmeal wool tunic, brown leather belt, heavy rust-orange wool mantle with two narrow dark-brown hem stripes, sandals
lifeStages.props: none fixed (nets, oars and boats belong to the scene)

lifeStages.appliesTo: Exodus 3 to Deuteronomy 34 (about 80 to 120). Earlier stages (infant, Egyptian prince, Midian shepherd) are out of scope for this prototype.
lifeStages.skin: deep olive-brown skin, sun-weathered and deeply lined
lifeStages.hairAndBeard: long white hair to the shoulders, a long full white beard to mid-chest, thick white eyebrows
lifeStages.facialNotes: long face, high cheekbones, prominent hooked nose, deep-set dark eyes
lifeStages.garments: ankle-length undyed cream wool tunic, deep madder-red mantle with a woven ochre border over one shoulder, brown leather belt, sandals
lifeStages.props: a tall, gnarled dark acacia-wood staff, taller than he is, with a curved crook at the top

locations.name: Sea of Galilee
locations.terrain: a broad green-blue freshwater lake ringed by hills; steep dark cliffs and flat-topped heights on the east shore; green slopes and a small plain to the north-west; black basalt pebble shores with reed beds
locations.architecture: flat-roofed black basalt fishing towns and low stone jetties; 8 m wooden fishing boats with dark tarred hulls, oars and one square sail
locations.vegetation: grassy slopes, scattered olive and carob trees, oleander, reeds, date palms
locations.landmarks: the sheer cliff of Mount Arbel on the north-west shore; snow-capped Mount Hermon far to the north

locations.name: Red Sea crossing site
locations.terrain: a wide arm of deep blue-green sea; a flat plain of pale sand and gravel on the near (western) shore; bare, jagged red-brown granite mountains on the far shore; when exposed, the seabed is rippled wet sand with shells, seaweed and dark rocks
locations.vegetation: almost none; scattered acacia and tamarisk shrubs and dry grass tufts on the shore
locations.landmarks: the jagged red-brown mountain range on the far shore; a rocky headland closing the bay to the north
